# Data Source: appwrite_messaging_topic

Fetches an Appwrite messaging topic by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "appwrite_messaging_topic" "notifications" {
  id = "notifications"
}

output "topic_name" {
  value = data.appwrite_messaging_topic.notifications.name
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The topic ID.

### Optional

- `project_id` (String) The Appwrite project ID. Defaults to the provider-level project_id.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) The topic creation timestamp.
- `name` (String) The topic name.
- `subscribe` (List of String) Subscribe permissions.
- `updated_at` (String) The topic last update timestamp.
